Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Karl-Anthony Towns?

Karl-Anthony Towns is 30 years old.

Where was Karl-Anthony Towns born?

Karl-Anthony Towns was born in Edison, New Jersey.

When was Karl-Anthony Towns born?

Karl-Anthony Towns was born on November 15, 1995.

How tall is Karl-Anthony Towns?

Karl-Anthony Towns is 7-0 (213 cm) tall.

How much does Karl-Anthony Towns weigh?

Karl-Anthony Towns weighs 248 lbs (112 kg).

Is Karl-Anthony Towns in the Hall of Fame?

Karl-Anthony Towns is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Karl-Anthony Towns drafted?

Karl-Anthony Towns was drafted by Minnesota Timberwolves, 1st round (1st pick, 1st overall), 2015 NBA Draft.

What position does Karl-Anthony Towns play?

Center and Power Forward.

What is Karl-Anthony Towns' net worth?

Karl-Anthony Towns has made at least $286,321,099 playing professional basketball.

How much does Karl-Anthony Towns make?

Karl-Anthony Towns made $53,142,264 in 2026.

How many rings does Karl-Anthony Towns have?

Karl-Anthony Towns has won one championship.

What is Karl-Anthony Towns' Instagram account?

Karl-Anthony Towns is on Instagram at karltowns.

What schools did Karl-Anthony Towns attend?

Karl-Anthony Towns attended St. Joseph in Metuchen, New Jersey and Kentucky.

What are Karl-Anthony Towns' nicknames?

Special K, KAT, Bodega K.A.T. are nicknames for Karl-Anthony Towns.
